entities.summary: Dmitry Vasilievich Stasov was a Russian lawyer who was a leading figure in the juridical reforms of the 1860s. He was the brother of the critic Vladimir Stasov and the activist Nadezhda Stasova. Stasov was father of the Bolshevik revolutionary Elena Stasova, and the writer and musicologist Varvara Stasova.
